title: Msiexec installs a remote web package
description: Detects Msiexec execution that references an MSI package over HTTP or HTTPS.

hypothesis.summary: An adversary may use Msiexec to retrieve and execute a remote installer package through a signed Windows binary.
hypothesis.rationale: MITRE documents remote MSI proxy execution and SigmaHQ maintains a comparable web-install analytic; combining Msiexec identity, a web protocol and an MSI reference is more specific than monitoring every Msiexec invocation.
hypothesis.detection_goal: Identify Msiexec commands that reference an MSI package over HTTP or HTTPS while leaving local packages, non-MSI URLs, unrelated executables and incomplete commands unmatched.

data_sources.name: Microsoft Defender for Endpoint process events

triage.summary: Validate the remote package source and installation owner before escalation; enterprise deployment tooling can legitimately install MSI packages from managed web locations.
steps: Review the complete command, URL, package name, account, initiating process and effective original filename.
Inspect DNS, network and file events for the package, then validate its signer, hash, installation actions and spawned processes.
Confirm the URL and package with the responsible software-deployment owner; scope exceptions to an approved source and package identity rather than Msiexec globally.
false_positives: Approved software deployment or repair workflows that install signed MSI packages from managed HTTP or HTTPS repositories

validation.expected_outcome: Match Msiexec commands containing an HTTP or HTTPS MSI reference; do not match local packages, non-MSI URLs, unrelated processes or missing command lines.
